question: What division of the eight octads is sought to be known completely?
premises: The subject concerns a division into eight octads.
Complete knowledge of this division is desired.
The desire extends to knowing it fully and without limit.
inference: The request seeks complete and exhaustive knowledge of the division of the eight octads.
uncertainties: anantathā may indicate endless extent or an infinite manner of knowing
plain_english: I wish to know fully and completely the division of the eight octads.
